title: Python Color Picker in 3 Steps

steps.title: Step 1: Setup
steps.explanation: We start by importing tkinter and setting up the main window with a title and size.

steps.title: Step 2: Create UI Elements
code_lines: label = tk.Label(root, text="Click to pick color", width=20, height=5)
steps.explanation: Next, we add a label and a button to the window. The button will trigger the color picker.

steps.title: Step 3: Handle Color Selection
steps.explanation: We define a function to open the color picker and update the label's background color.

steps.title: Step 4: Run the App
steps.explanation: Finally, we start the application with the main loop. Try it yourself and pick your favorite color!

intro_hook: Ever wanted to pick colors in Python? Let's build a simple app!
